report.title: Measure Rigidity beyond Homogeneous Dynamics

report.question: How can smooth nonhomogeneous dynamics reconstruct leafwise algebraic symmetry, upgrade stationary measures to invariant ones, and constrain geometric supports and orbit closures?
report.reading_scope: Read the complete official mathematical HTML, §§1-6.4, all displayed definitions/theorems/conjectures and proof-outline paragraphs, bibliography 1-62, Figure 1 caption, publication and license metadata. Figure 1 pixels and the official PDF were not visually inspected or reproduced. Supplementary readings are targeted full-text ranges listed below, not complete readings of the cited long papers.
report.coverage_status: 54 atomic pages 3701-370Z and 3710-371I, narrative overview 3700, reference icm2026-filip. Keeps entries to random stationary rigidity, cocycle/normal-form geometry, finite-cover generalized u-Gibbs/QNI/factorization, K3, symplectic, geodesic, translation-surface and character-variety directions. Deep results are cited with stated assumptions; 370X is explicitly a proof outline. Main SL2/product consequences are represented through 371A-371B without expanding the entire general SL2-action theorem.

proof_scope.3701: Defines stationarity, invariance and ergodicity as extremality; proves invariance implies stationarity.
proof_scope.3702: Constructs the Cantor law from independent digits, verifies stationarity and explicitly disproves individual invariance.
proof_scope.3703: Proves stationary existence by telescoping Cesaro averages and weak compactness; does not claim pointwise random-path convergence.
proof_scope.3704: Proves uniformity on a transitive finite permutation orbit using the maximum principle.
proof_scope.3705: Proves invariance of the one-sided skew product on rectangles and the converse on Q-marginals.
proof_scope.3706: Defines finite measurable extension and pulled-back leaf geometry; no topological covering asserted.
proof_scope.3707: Proves basis independence and the additive chain rule for logarithmic d-volume growth.
proof_scope.3708: States the exact quantifiers and single N-step convolution normalization.
proof_scope.3709: States flag-based signed gap without conflating it with a gap between distinct exponents.
proof_scope.3710: Recalls the existing K3 definition, proves scalar action and modulus-one multiplier using integration, hence canonical invariant volume.
proof_scope.3711: Proves equivalence of total reality, zero intersection with J-plane and complex spanning for a real two-plane.
proof_scope.3712: States the four-way conjecture with finite-support generating measure; explicitly defines associated empirical limits and retains the source's quantifier over all ergodic stationary measures, without applying a single-stratum classification to nonergodic mixtures.
proof_scope.3713: States zero-exponent support conjecture and derives only invariance via stiffness in the finite-support ergodic setting.
proof_scope.3714: Cites exact positive-entropy absolute-continuity Kummer theorem including nonprojective K3; no proof reconstruction.
proof_scope.3715: States an explicitly ergodic, finite-support version of the survey symplectic conjecture; defines isotropic subspaces and keeps midpoint gap and orbit convergence.
proof_scope.3716: States compact real-analytic negative-sectional-curvature hypersurface rigidity with dimension and distinct closed immersed hypotheses.
proof_scope.3717: Preserves higher-codimension maximal totally geodesic conjecture as open; distinguishes local symmetry from constant real sectional curvature.
proof_scope.3718: Defines good maximal pairs and presents infinitely-many-implies-structure as a research principle, not universal theorem.
proof_scope.3719: Fully computes the Heisenberg coadjoint orbit and KKS form; general central-extension classification only contextual.
proof_scope.370A: Proves metric independence by N-block iteration and bounded endpoint errors, for expansion and signed gaps.
proof_scope.370B: Proves openness using finite words and compact Grassmann/flag bundles, with fixed finite support labels.
proof_scope.370C: Defines base-measurable common invariant subbundle and determinant exponent sum, excluding path-dependent Oseledets subspaces.
proof_scope.370D: States stiffness for compact finite-support C-infinity random diffeomorphisms and ergodic stationary measure, testing every common invariant measurable subbundle.
proof_scope.370E: States finite-or-normalized-volume theorem retaining compactness, finite support, common smooth volume, all dimensions and ergodicity; cites deep classification.
proof_scope.370F: States the invertible ergodic MET with two-sided logarithmic integrability; theorem external.
proof_scope.370G: States compact smooth Pesin stable manifolds with measurable variation; existence proof external. Center-stable jets moved to 371G.
proof_scope.370H: Defines disintegration and leafwise projective measures, explicitly separating plaque probabilities from full-leaf locally finite measures.
proof_scope.370I: Defines function jets with coordinate-independent equivalence, fiber dimension and chain-rule action.
proof_scope.370J: Defines smooth-natural, recursively forward/backward dynamically defined cocycles, and admissible cocycles as measurable isometric subquotients of a smooth-natural envelope; distinguishes construction data from measurable isomorphism classes.
proof_scope.370K: Defines weighted subresonance explicitly by monomials, with constants and invertibility convention.
proof_scope.370L: Proves finite-dimensionality and closure under polynomial composition using weighted degree.
proof_scope.370M: Computes the full two-dimensional form, exact inverse and invertibility condition.
proof_scope.370N: Uses F-id of strictly negative weight and proves both failures of the D0F=I equivalence with a shear and a resonant quadratic.
proof_scope.370O: Constructs a finite linear lift including the constant coordinate, proves equivariance and injectivity.
proof_scope.370P: States compact C-infinity normal-form theorem with measurable charts, normalization and chart transitions; proof cited.
proof_scope.370Q: Defines G-X structures and subresonant structures; affine equal-weight case proved by weight bound.
proof_scope.370R: Fully proves contraction-recurrence vanishing for a measurable equivariant section; Cartan application is a consequence, not a prerequisite.
proof_scope.370S: States all four compatibility conditions on the finite measurable extension, including orbit-measure maximality and positive orbit dimension.
proof_scope.370T: Defines generalized u-Gibbs on finite extension, distinguishing partial orbit Haar from full-leaf absolute continuity.
proof_scope.370U: Defines orbit-translate space and linearization quotient as cited construction; proves the elementary horizontal-translation model.
proof_scope.370V: Gives exact original QNI quantifiers, y-dependent stable subsets, reverse-time stable atoms, ambient infimum distance and fixed realized cs jets.
proof_scope.370W: States original enlargement theorem in compact smooth-flow setting on the specified finite measurable extension; finite induction consequence proved.
proof_scope.370X: Proof scheme only; corrects q1'=g_l q' and explains nontrivial separation, compact uniformity, finer conditionals and finite-cover role.
proof_scope.370Y: Proves the final algebraic entropy squeeze conditional on explicitly cited geometric entropy estimates; uses equality iff invariant.
proof_scope.370Z: Proves support inclusion for averaged distributions and constructs a compact smooth diffeomorphism counterexample to equality.
proof_scope.371A: Defines translation surface, zero-order cone angle, SL2 action and area preservation via direct coordinate calculation.
proof_scope.371B: States product-stratum P-to-SL2 invariance and equality of orbit closures; single-factor affine explanation only, avoiding unverified independent-scaling affine convention.
proof_scope.371C: Defines compact-group character quotient, proves the U(1) torus case and distinguishes coarse quotient from stack.
proof_scope.371D: Proves well-defined left action on representation conjugacy classes, including inner automorphism and composition checks.
proof_scope.371E: Defines algebro-geometric subgroup with smooth projective curve family and quasi-projective base; proves marking conjugacy.
proof_scope.371F: Computes positive Laplacian of the logarithmic Hodge norm in genus one; no general character-variety rigidity theorem claimed.
proof_scope.371G: Separates equivariant formal center-stable jets and chosen smooth realizations; existence and representative-independence inputs cited.
proof_scope.371H: States all Cartan connection axioms and curvature, with local flatness theorem cited.
proof_scope.371I: Defines finite connected locally embedded strata and strict dimension drop for distinct strata; checks all frontier incidences in the closed-interval example.

remaining_branches: General SL2-action rigidity beyond the product-of-strata consequences is not separately expanded into a fully technical theorem; its place in the report is preserved through the overview and translation-surface branch.
Full factorization construction, inert subspaces, eight-point selection, fine conditional measures and extra-invariance proof in BFERH §§7-12 remain external.
Normal-form existence, finite measurable-cover construction, quotient-H construction, Cartan-connection construction and geometric entropy estimates remain cited deep inputs.

The product affine-invariant-submanifold convention involving independent factor scalings requires further clarification; 371B states only P-to-SL2 invariance and equality of orbit closures, plus the standard single-factor affine context.

K3/symplectic/higher-codimension geodesic questions remain conjectural. Character-variety measure classification is described in official §6.4 as joint work in preparation; 371C-371F define the setting and prove only elementary consequences and a genus-one Hodge-norm calculation.

Further regularity criteria for uniform expansion, canonical-height/Galois equidistribution arguments and arithmetic/typical-atypical refinements are kept as source directions, not standalone proved results.
normalization_notes: F_N=f_N composed ... composed f_1 is one N-step random composition. Integrate sigma_d(F,L) against mu^{*N}(F); do not iterate that sampled F another N times.
All d=1,...,dimQ-1 expansion and signed-gap hypotheses are kept for finite-or-volume; compact connected C-infinity finite-support setting and common smooth volume are explicit.
Stiffness tests the exponent sum of every base-defined common invariant measurable subbundle, not path-dependent random Oseledets subspaces.
Strict subresonance means id+Poly^{<0}, equivalently identity on the full polynomial-linearization associated graded, not D_0F=I.

QNI follows BFERH Definition 3.2.2 rather than the schematic survey formula. Stable atoms have reversed time, the stable denominator carries the minus sign, stable subsets may depend on the chosen unstable point, and finite-cover distance is pulled back from Q.
Normal-form/Pesin statements use the compact smooth single-map special case; random applications use the skew-product/finite-cover framework.

K3 Conjecture 6.2 is specialized to finite support. Associated measures are defined as weak limits of averaged orbit distributions, and the source's every-ergodic-stationary-measure quantifier is explicit.
Symplectic Conjecture 6.4 is presented in an explicitly ergodic finite-support form; arbitrary convex mixtures are not asserted to be a single smooth-stratum volume.

The finite-stratification definition is independent at 371I and requires the frontier inequality only between distinct strata. 3712, 3715 and 3718 no longer treat a K3 conjecture as a definition prerequisite.
3717 keeps the closed, distinct-image proper-submanifold formulation 2<=k<dimM; this is a restricted geometric version rather than a verbatim assertion about arbitrary local immersed disks.
Cartan brackets use lbrack/rbrack to avoid Forester interpreting [omega,omega](v,w) as a link. Unicode C¹ occurs only in title/prose/link labels, not native math.
